children: Motilal Oswal's research report on Tech Mahindra

Tech Mahindra (TECHM) reported 2QFY27 revenue of USD1.7b, up 2.4% QoQ in CC, above our estimate of 1.7% CC growth. Retail/Communication/Technology rose 9.6%/6.0%/2.8% QoQ, Others/Manufacturing declined 15.0%/3.9% QoQ (in USD terms). EBIT margin expanded 40bp QoQ to 14.8%, above our estimates of 14.4%. Adj. PAT stood at INR16b (up 8.2% QoQ/32.8% YoY), below our estimate of INR17b. Net new deal TCV was USD1,023m, down 5.1% QoQ and up 25.4% YoY. In INR terms, revenue/EBIT/adj. PAT grew 16.6%/46.4%/30.6% YoY in 1HFY27. In 2HFY27, we expect revenue/EBIT/adj. PAT to grow by 11.7%/28.7%/44.7% YoY.
We value TECHM at 20x FY28E EPS with a TP of INR1,950 (18% upside) and reiterate our BUY rating. TECHM remains our preferred pick among large-cap IT companies.
